title: Distribution of the magnetization of the critical Ising model on sparse random graphs
summary: In this paper, we consider the Ising model on random $d$-regular graphs (with $d\ge3$) and Erdös-Rényi graphs $G(n,d/n)$ (with $d>1$) at the critical temperature. We prove that the \textit{magnetization}, i.e.\ the sum of the spins of a configuration, is typically of order $n^{3/4}$ and when multiplied by $n^{-3/4}$ converges in distribution to a non-trivial random variable, whose density we describe.
